forecast_note: Forward forecast computed by Rishabh using Kalpaang's exact documented Model B methodology (Linear Regression, time index + calendar-month dummies) from his v2 script — refit on the full 60 months (not just the 48-month train split) per standard practice before producing a genuine forward forecast, then extrapolated to t=60,61,62 for Jan-Mar 2024. Validated by reproducing Kalpaang's exact reported holdout numbers first (R²=0.612, MAE=823,749 on his 12-month test split) before refitting — confirms this uses his real, documented method, not an approximation. February 2024 is predicted lowest, consistent with the real seasonal dip observed in every prior year (2019-2023).
note: Re-run in full on the corrected v2 dataset. The v1 result (LR R²=0.673, RF R²=-3.84) was driven almost entirely by a fake rising-volume trend (a Sales Date construction bug, since fixed) — Random Forest failed in v1 because it cannot extrapolate a trend. With the artifact removed, both models now fit a genuinely flat, seasonal series: Linear Regression with calendar-month dummies explains 61.2% of held-out variance; Random Forest is now competitive (47.1%) rather than catastrophically wrong. Order-level Sales prediction (Model A: Quantity/Discount/Age/Category/Region/Outlet/City/Segment) remains R≈ 0 on both dataset versions — confirmed genuine dataset limitation, not a modeling error.
